items.problem: `#slot` prunes at the time of each line written, so after a line at a later test clock time, a judgement or line at an earlier time after `set_time` moved the clock back no longer counts the lines dropped at that later time. `### alert signal` sets no upper bound on the window and does not say what happens when the clock goes back. The behaviour existed before this range, where the old `#slot` also pruned at each line. The spec needs to say what a judgement counts after the clock went back, or the implementation has to keep every line
